I got my makeup done by Komal Pedamkar for my baby shower, and I must say — she did a fantastic job! The makeup looked absolutely beautiful and stayed completely intact throughout the function, even though we had a major power cut for most of the event which led to quite a bit of sweating.

Surprisingly, the makeup didn’t budge at all! It stayed flawless from start to finish. It’s been hours since the function ended, and I still don’t feel like removing it — that’s how fresh and light it feels on my skin.

Being 7 months pregnant, my skin has become very sensitive lately, but Komal used products that were clearly well-suited for my skin type. It’s almost the end of the day now and I haven’t experienced any irritation or discomfort.

Thank you so much, Komal, for making me feel so confident and comfortable on such a special day. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for a skilled, thoughtful, and reliable makeup artist!
